question: Which of the following States have enacted the Cattle Preservation Act, 2021 in July-August 2021 to regulate slaughter and transport of cattle and proposed an amendment in December 2021 to allow inter-district transportation of cattle for agricultural and animal husbandry except in districts sharing international border?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• The Assam Cattle Preservation Act, 2021 was enacted to regulate the slaughter, consumption, and transportation of cattle in the state.

• It was introduced in July-August 2021 and aimed at preserving and protecting cattle, while prohibiting their slaughter except under certain conditions.

• In December 2021, an amendment was proposed to allow the inter-district transportation of cattle for agricultural and animal husbandry purposes, except in districts sharing an international border.

• This amendment was aimed at addressing the concerns of farmers and cattle owners while ensuring the protection and preservation of cattle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Assam Cattle Preservation Act, 2021:**

• The act aims to regulate the slaughter, consumption, and transportation of cattle in Assam.

• It prohibits the slaughter of cattle except under certain conditions, such as when the cattle are over 14 years of age or have become permanently incapacitated.

• The act also restricts the sale and purchase of beef and beef products within areas predominantly inhabited by non-beef-eating communities.

• Transport of cattle within the state and to other states is also regulated to prevent illegal trade and smuggling.

• **Agricultural and Animal Husbandry:**

• Agriculture and animal husbandry are crucial sectors in Assam, providing livelihood to a large part of the population.

• Cattle play an essential role in agricultural activities such as ploughing fields and providing manure.

• Animal husbandry involves the breeding, raising, and caring for animals, including cattle, for various purposes like milk, meat, and labor.

• The amendment to the act aims to facilitate the movement of cattle within the state for legitimate agricultural and husbandry purposes, while still preventing illegal activities.

• **International Border Districts:**

• Assam shares international borders with Bhutan and Bangladesh.

• Districts sharing international borders are subject to stricter regulations to prevent cross-border smuggling and illegal trade.

• The amendment to the Cattle Preservation Act excludes these border districts from the relaxed transportation norms to ensure security and prevent illegal activities.
